text_simplified: Group play helps children learn cooperation, sharing, and respect for others' rights, while also nurturing intelligence, creativity, and skills. Play must remain Islamically permissible, free of prohibited acts or neglecting obligations. Prophetic etiquette also includes keeping young children indoors at the onset of nightfall around Maghrib, as authentically reported from the Prophet (peace be upon him) in the Sahihayn.
